args.body:
Hi Dora! I just visited www.dora-website.com — thanks for sharing it. A few thoughts:

- It's a clean, simple personal page, which makes it easy to read at a glance.
- Right now it's very minimal: just a short intro and your email. Adding a bit more about who you are, what you do, and what you're interested in would help visitors connect with you.
- Consider adding a photo or avatar, links to your social/professional profiles, and maybe a projects or blog section.
- Making your email a clickable mailto: link would make it easier for people to reach you.
- A page title and short meta description would help with search engines and link previews.

Nice start — with a little more content it'll be a great personal site!

Hi Eve! I just visited www.eve-blog.com — thanks for sharing it. A few thoughts:

- I love that you lead with your hobby — hiking is a great theme for a blog and gives it personality.
- The page is quite sparse right now. Adding actual posts (trip reports, trail recommendations, photos from hikes) would give visitors a reason to come back.
- Photos would make a hiking blog really shine — consider a gallery or a featured image per post.
- Adding an About section, a way to subscribe or follow along, and a list of recent posts would round it out.
- A page title and short meta description would help with search and link previews.

Great foundation — I'd love to read about your favorite trails!
